headline: Seoul stocks open sharply higher on chip gains, easing Mideast tensions
summary: South Korean stocks opened sharply higher, led by tech heavyweights, after the Nasdaq Composite posted back-to-back record closes. Easing Mideast tensions were also cited.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main equity benchmark, and its large chip makers are sensitive to global technology demand and US tech stock moves.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: Back-to-back record closes in the Nasdaq Composite set the tone for tech stocks in Seoul.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Tech heavyweights led gains after the Nasdaq Composite posted back-to-back record closes, and easing Mideast tensions added to the positive sentiment.
